<script>
const LANGS = ['eu', 'en', 'es'];
function setLang(lang) {
  LANGS.forEach(l => {
    document.getElementById('block-' + l)?.classList.toggle('active', l === lang);
    document.getElementById('sidebar-' + l)?.classList.toggle('active', l === lang);
    document.getElementById('sl-int-' + l)?.classList.toggle('active', l === lang);
    document.getElementById('btn-' + l)?.classList.toggle('active', l === lang);
  });
  localStorage.setItem('cv-lang', lang);
}
(function() {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem('cv-lang');
  if (saved && LANGS.includes(saved)) { setLang(saved); return; }
  const nav = (navigator.language || '').toLowerCase();
  if (nav.startsWith('eu')) setLang('eu');
  else if (nav.startsWith('es')) setLang('es');
  else setLang('en');
})();
</script>
